breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the product of inertia even though the setup explicitly gives a nonzero I_yz and the unsymmetric bending formula depends on it.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the full unsymmetric bending formula that includes the product of inertia Iyz = 800,000 mm^4 in all terms. It explicitly removes the erroneous instruction to 'superpose My·z/Iy and Mz·y/Iz as though the product of inertia were zero' and instead uses the complete formula σ = −(My·Iz − Mz·Iyz)/(Iy·Iz − Iyz^2)·z − (Mz·Iy − My·Iyz)/(Iy·Iz − Iyz^2)·y, properly accounting for the nonzero Iyz throughout the calculation.
